response: The results of studies suggest that the temperature used during cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) does not prevent the development of postoperative euthyroid sick syndrome. Specifically, normothermic CPB has been found to not prevent the development of this condition, and despite changes in thyroid function, most patients have a normal postoperative recovery. Therefore, cardiopulmonary bypass temperature does not appear to have a significant impact on the development of postoperative euthyroid sick syndrome.
